departments.name: Cardiology
departments.shortDescription: Heart care from prevention to complex interventions.
departments.description: Our Heart Institute brings together interventional cardiologists, cardiac surgeons and rehab specialists. We manage everything from blood pressure and cholesterol to angioplasty, pacemakers and heart-failure programmes with a 24×7 cath lab.

departments.name: Neurology
departments.shortDescription: Brain, spine and nerve disorders under one roof.
departments.description: The Neurosciences team treats stroke, epilepsy, migraine, Parkinson's disease and neuropathies. A dedicated stroke-ready pathway ensures clot-busting treatment within the golden hour.

departments.name: Orthopedics
departments.shortDescription: Joints, bones, sports injuries and spine care.
departments.description: From fractures to robotic-assisted joint replacement, our orthopaedic surgeons and physiotherapists work together to get you moving again — safely and quickly.

departments.name: Pediatrics
departments.shortDescription: Child-friendly care from newborns to teens.
departments.description: Our paediatricians provide well-baby visits, vaccinations, developmental assessments and a Level-III NICU for premature and critically ill newborns.

departments.name: Gynecology & Obstetrics
departments.description: Comprehensive women's health — antenatal care, high-risk pregnancy, painless delivery, laparoscopic gynae surgery and menopause clinics in a warm, private setting.

departments.name: Dermatology
departments.shortDescription: Skin, hair and nail treatments backed by science.
departments.description: Medical and aesthetic dermatology for acne, eczema, psoriasis, pigmentation and hair loss, including laser and procedure rooms.

departments.name: ENT
departments.shortDescription: Ear, nose, throat and hearing care.
departments.description: Endoscopic sinus surgery, hearing assessments, voice clinic and paediatric ENT — delivered with modern endoscopy and audiology equipment.

departments.name: General Medicine
departments.shortDescription: Your first stop for fevers, diabetes and more.
departments.description: Internal medicine specialists manage fevers, infections, diabetes, thyroid, hypertension and preventive health checks, coordinating referrals when you need a super-specialist.

departments.name: Dentistry
departments.shortDescription: Healthy smiles for the whole family.
departments.description: General, cosmetic and surgical dentistry — root canals, implants, aligners and children's dentistry in sterile, modern dental chairs.

departments.name: Radiology
departments.description: CT, MRI, ultrasound, mammography and digital X-ray with same-day reporting by experienced radiologists.

departments.name: Emergency & Trauma
departments.description: A 20-bed emergency department staffed round the clock by emergency physicians, with triage, resuscitation bays, and advanced life-support ambulances.

departments.name: General Surgery
departments.description: Laparoscopic gall-bladder, hernia, appendix and bariatric procedures with enhanced recovery protocols for shorter hospital stays.

doctors.name: Dr. Arjun Mehta
doctors.about: Dr. Mehta has performed over 4,000 angioplasties and leads the hospital's primary-PCI programme for heart attacks. He is passionate about preventive cardiology and patient education.

doctors.name: Dr. Kavya Iyer
doctors.about: Dr. Iyer heads the stroke-ready pathway and epilepsy clinic. She has trained in video-EEG monitoring and believes in shared decision-making with families.

doctors.name: Dr. Rohan Kapoor
doctors.about: Specialist in robotic-assisted knee and hip replacements and arthroscopic sports surgery. He has helped hundreds of patients walk pain-free again.

doctors.name: Dr. Sneha Reddy
doctors.about: Dr. Reddy runs the well-baby and vaccination clinics and supervises the NICU. Parents love her calm, reassuring approach.

doctors.name: Dr. Farah Khan
doctors.about: Dr. Khan specialises in high-risk pregnancy and laparoscopic gynae surgery, with a strong focus on natural and painless childbirth.

doctors.name: Dr. Nikhil Bansal
doctors.about: Dr. Bansal treats chronic skin conditions and performs laser and aesthetic procedures, with an evidence-first philosophy.

doctors.name: Dr. Priya Nair
doctors.about: Expert in endoscopic sinus surgery and pediatric ENT. Dr. Nair also runs the vertigo clinic.

doctors.name: Dr. Imran Qureshi
doctors.about: With two decades in internal medicine, Dr. Qureshi manages complex fevers, diabetes and hypertension and is known for thorough, unhurried consultations.

doctors.name: Dr. Ananya Das
doctors.about: Dr. Das performs painless root canals and smile makeovers, and runs the kids' dentistry clinic on Saturdays.

doctors.name: Dr. Vikram Singh
doctors.about: Dr. Singh leads imaging services and specialises in musculoskeletal MRI and image-guided biopsies.

doctors.name: Dr. Suresh Menon
doctors.about: Dr. Menon heads the 24×7 emergency department and trains staff in advanced trauma and cardiac life support.

doctors.name: Dr. Meera Joshi
doctors.about: Dr. Joshi performs advanced laparoscopic and day-care surgeries with enhanced-recovery protocols so patients go home sooner.

education.institute: Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India

doctors.name: Dr. Aditya Rao
doctors.about: Focuses on hypertension, heart failure and cardiac imaging. Runs the evening cardiology clinic for working professionals.

doctors.name: Dr. Pooja Saxena
doctors.about: Dr. Saxena runs the diabetes & thyroid clinic, with structured education programmes for newly diagnosed patients.
